title: Unitary and Nonunitary Representations of the Heisenberg-Weyl Lie Algebra
summary: We examine unitary and nonunitary representations of the Heisenberg-Weyl Lie algebra $\mathfrak{hw}_n$, with particular emphasis on tensor products of unitary representations and on indecomposable nonunitary representations. In the unitary setting, the irreducible representations with nontrivial central character are the Schrödinger representations, as classified by the Stone-von Neumann theorem.
